about: lore's own code. Gold ranges point at code and migrations, not docs: a hit in docs/ is a miss.

questions.q: what kinds of documents can lore store?
questions.answer: code, doc, session, note

questions.q: which directories and files does a repo push never index?
questions.answer: directories node_modules, vendor, dist, build, target, .git, .venv, __pycache__; files package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum; names ending in .min.js, .map and image, archive and font suffixes; files over 256 KiB

questions.q: what states can a repo push be in?
questions.answer: waiting, fetching, indexing, done, failed

questions.q: which tools can the deep mode agent call?
questions.answer: search, grep, read_file, get_session

questions.q: what columns does the chunks table have?
questions.answer: id, tenant_id, document_id, ord, text, start_line, end_line, symbols, tsv, embedding vector(384), and enumerates (added in 0006)

questions.q: how are API keys stored in the database?
questions.answer: api_keys rows with tenant_id, a display prefix, key_hash (hex SHA-256 of the key, unique), scopes text[], created_at and revoked_at; the plaintext is never stored

questions.q: what is stored for each span received over OTLP?
questions.answer: spans table: tenant_id, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, session_id, name, kind, start_time, end_time, status_code, status_message, resource, attributes, events, received_at; primary key (tenant_id, trace_id, span_id)

questions.q: what fields does a search hit have in the HTTP response?
questions.answer: chunk_id, document_id, source, kind, title, uri, path, external_id, start_line, end_line, symbols, snippet, score

questions.q: where is a bearer token checked against the stored API keys?
questions.answer: caller_from_headers in src/auth.rs: it hashes the token and looks it up in api_keys where revoked_at is null

questions.q: where does the CLI retry with a full bundle when the server asks for one?
questions.answer: upload_bundle in src/cli/repo.rs, on a 409 need_full_bundle (is_need_full_bundle)

questions.q: where are the HTTP routes registered?
questions.answer: router() in src/http/mod.rs

questions.q: where does lore decide which session a span belongs to?
questions.answer: session_id() in src/otlp/mod.rs: span session.id, then gen_ai.conversation.id, then the resource's session.id, then the trace id

questions.q: what is the default time budget of a deep mode question?
questions.answer: 30 seconds (LORE_DEEP_BUDGET_SECS)

questions.q: which embedding model does lore use, and how many dimensions do its vectors have?
questions.answer: bge-small-en-v1.5, 384 dimensions

questions.q: how large can an uploaded git bundle be by default?
questions.answer: 512 MiB (LORE_MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES)

questions.q: how long must a session go without new spans before it is indexed?
questions.answer: 60 seconds by default (LORE_SESSION_QUIET_SECS)

questions.q: how are the full-text and vector results merged into one ranking?
questions.answer: Reciprocal Rank Fusion with k = 60: each list adds 1 / (60 + rank); ties go to the better lexical rank, then the lower chunk id

questions.q: how does fast mode decide how many passages go into the prompt?
questions.answer: it numbers the hits (12 by default) and adds them while the whole message stays within 60,000 characters, each passage cut to its first 120 lines

questions.q: how is a new API key generated?
questions.answer: lk_ followed by the hex of 20 random bytes from the OS (40 hex characters); the first 11 characters are kept as the prefix and the SHA-256 hex is stored

questions.q: when does the deep mode agent stop calling tools and answer?
questions.answer: once more than 80% of the time budget has passed or the round cap is reached, the model gets one last call without tools and is told to answer
